issue.body:
Slice T42, canonical `patches-shipped`, M6.P2 under area epic #1054. Run the coordinator's proved `docs/reviews/briefs/patches-shipped.md` v2 under plan §6b. D-WORKFLOW-225 records scope, evidence and ownership. The live checklist below is the execution contract; the dispatch comment names the exact commit, seed, branch and worktree.

## Scope

384 native patch rows / 71,387 logical Git-blob lines, 71,378 newline bytes; 380 regular files plus four symlinks; 379 shipped/five test. All vendor-carried, with twelve fork-written paths / 498 lines identified by tier_note, including Dolphin. A separate table answers T40's 50 inherited questions / 26 overrides; prior recipe acceptance is context, not adoption. No source/recipe/config/patch/ledger/rule edits or removals. T41/T43/T11/T27/T3/T17 boundaries remain as the brief states. Local depth, actual Codex/OpenAI reader, no external reviewer.

reviewed-at: 9dd0716033f8831ffbd0b5ee8efbb5e5a066cfb1

Can this be done on the VM? No — this table reads source, selection, provenance and safe cached-source application bytes. No runtime behavior is claimed. No build, guest, config sourcing, fetch, physical/cloud action, provider call, runtime allocation or host-ledger write. Missing input is an explicit open item, not evidence of application or permission to download it.

- [x] Every application claim names its proved source pin, safe extraction, stack/order, literal/rendered patch and tree hashes, selected values/backend, normal/diagnostic receipts and classification; missing inputs remain open items. A partial-failure guard rejects promotion and blocks successors.
- [x] The asserted table generator's four negative controls fail before its positive output passes; counts by disposition and status sum to their own populations.
- [x] 04 answers Q1–Q7 with Q5's explicit measurement limits; 03 carries conformance, interactions and refutation; matching classified proof and running-log entries state their limits.
- [x] review-plan.json records the actual reader/lab/identity source, reviewers [], Local tier exception and historical identity honestly; no external review claim.
- [x] Pre-issue lint passes before D; final resolution lint passes normally and with the audit issue; every punch row has a Phase-7 outcome with evidence/owner.

- [x] No lane commit changes native/inherited source paths, recipes, configs, tools/scripts, rules, registers or survey ledgers. Tree-diff and commit-path guards fail on a planted source edit in a disposable fixture.
- [x] All inherited and contribution rows name their owners and exact action; #585 lines are drafts never sent, class removal stays #1048/#346.
- [x] The execution census shows no build, guest, device/cloud, config sourcing, fetch or host-ledger write. Source scratch is retained until acceptance and retired only at H under its owned path.

- [x] Final retro states outcomes, friction, next owners and untouched time-to-play numbers; the hand-back names one clean published tip and actual artifact paths.
- [x] reviewed-at/fixed-at in #689 match the immutable read and final source-preserving tip; the coordinator verifies the simulated integration and records acceptance. Slice closure/status waits for its actual integration convention.

audit.body:
Local audit of T42 #689, M6.P2 under area #1054. **1 finding: 0 Critical, 0 High, 1 Medium.** The native 384-path provenance/coverage population is separate from the 50 inherited comparisons / 26 overrides.

Primary reader: Codex / GPT-6-Astra / xhigh, OpenAI, T5 wN:p7, session 01a19d12-3d7a-7642-9108-ae06a719cdd7. Reviewers: []; Local under D-WORKFLOW-184/225. reviewed-at: 9dd0716033f8831ffbd0b5ee8efbb5e5a066cfb1. No external review or runtime result.

Artifact root: `docs/audits/2026_11_02-epic-m6-patches-shipped/` on `feature/m6-patches-shipped-689`; the clean immutable D tip will be linked in the #689 publication checkpoint. 02 carries all tables/receipts; 03 conformance and refutation; 04 Q1–Q7 and final-criteria limits; 05 punch details; 06/07 D summary and owner choices.

## Finding and route proposed

PL-01 / F-T42-01: Q3, Bug, Medium. PPSSPP007 outer diff adds a nested .patch; its intended SDL hunk remains text. Source trace: seed patch lines 11–29, recipe post_unpack and scripts/unpack:191–196. Constructed fixture normal rc 0 creates the nested file with unchanged SDL sentinel; this is not an application-at-pin or runtime claim. Reactive bug **#1410** holds the exact trace and observable criteria; it has no milestone/parent and remains open.

Already written: the selected outer patch leaves the original SDL mapping and an inert file in build source; it does not write player settings or cloud data. A future correction rebuilds the affected binary while preserving `/storage`.

Can this be done on the VM? Source/format facts are host source-fixture facts. Later input behavior can be exercised in GENERIC_X64 without a named physical exception; no runtime is allocated here.

Enforcement ladder: written/routed patch intent → audited source-target regression. Next mechanism: coordinator assigns a separate PPSSPP fix brief that first fails on the wrapper, then proves the selected direct source change and no nested target. Fixed upstream maps GUIDE to NKCODE_GUIDE while the nested seed payload requests NKCODE_UNKNOWN; the owner must resolve that intent before importing it. A narrow product-patch target guard can cover siblings with intentional exceptions. No production guard or source fix is made by this audit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] PL-01 has a coordinator-approved Phase-7 disposition with evidence and owner in 05's table and matching punch_index; #1410 retains its truthful state until its own implementation/acceptance completes.
- [x] Final resolution `tools/lint-audit-artifacts` passes normally and with this audit issue, with actual outputs retained after disposition.
- [x] The coordinator verifies the clean published source-preserving packet and records #689's acceptance under its integration convention.

## Bounded results

Native worst-per-plan application: 151 applies, 38 offset, 22 fuzz, 173 explicit open items. 760 recorded normal/diagnostic pairs and 116 safe cached-source target projections are checked; two link-creating UCM candidate exits were not serialized and are unclaimed. No whole-component/runtime/efficiency PASS. Inherited: 21 already-carried, seven not-applicable with individual reasons, 22 owner-specific missing inputs. Those existing comparison questions are not extra bugs. All twelve fork-written members / 498 lines were read; #585 contributions remain drafts in the packet.

Four table-corruption controls fail their own assertions; working and committed-then-reverted source edits fail protected-path fixtures. Literal pre-issue result before filing: `PASS pre-issue artifacts (does not certify resolution)`. Stage D stops for coordinator disposition; no E–H or source remediation is assumed.

bug.title: ppsspp-sa: home-pause patch creates a nested patch instead of changing SDL
bug.body:
T42 source audit F-T42-01 / PL-01 found that the selected PPSSPP patch creates an inert nested patch instead of changing the intended SDL source. This is a reactive bug, with no milestone or parent; #689 owns the audit record, and the standalone-emulator owner (#677 context) owns any future correction.

## Source trace

Reviewed source: `9dd0716033f8831ffbd0b5ee8efbb5e5a066cfb1`.

- `projects/ROCKNIX/packages/emulators/standalone/ppsspp-sa/package.mk:5` pins `afbc66a318b86432642b532c575241f3716642ef` (v1.20.2).
- Its `patches/007-disable-home-pause.patch:11–16` is an outer diff creating `package/batocera/emulators/ppsspp/007-disable-home-pause.patch`.
- Lines 17–29 are added text containing the intended `SDL/SDLJoystick.cpp` hunk, including GUIDE mapping `NKCODE_BACK` → `NKCODE_UNKNOWN`.
- `scripts/unpack:191–196` applies the outer patch once. The recipe's post_unpack hook only adjusts compiler flag files; no hook applies the created nested file.

Consequently this patch does not perform its advertised SDL change. A successful patch exit can conceal the defect. Fixed upstream `651150fc88` has a direct SDL diff returning `NKCODE_GUIDE`, a different mapping from the nested payload; importing it requires an explicit intended-behavior decision by the owning fix stream.

## Evidence and limits

`docs/audits/2026_11_02-epic-m6-patches-shipped/stage-b/nested-patch/receipt.json` retains a constructed fixture: GNU patch 2.8 diagnostic and normal rc 0, nested target created, sentinel SDLJoystick.cpp byte-identical. This proves the wrapper mechanism, not application at the actual PPSSPP pin or observed player behavior. Source/recipe/unpack readbacks and duplicate searches are under `stage-b/source-context/`. The sibling scan found one product-path instance; 23 other hits are legitimate historical product-diff evidence.

Severity: Medium. No data-loss or security consequence is demonstrated.

Already written: builds containing the outer patch may keep the preexisting SDL mapping and an inert nested file in their build source. This patch writes no player settings or cloud data. A correction must rebuild the affected binary and preserve existing `/storage`; editing the audit alone repairs no installed image.

Can this be done on the VM? The source-target regression can be proved from source fixtures without a guest. The later input-flow check can run in GENERIC_X64 with injected controller input; no physical fact is required. This issue grants no runtime allocation or device/cloud action.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A source regression fails on the reviewed wrapper, then passes on the chosen direct SDL diff: exact selected pin/stack, actual normal rc, before/after target hashes and absence of the nested patch file are retained.
- [ ] The intended GUIDE mapping is recorded and exercised in GENERIC_X64 with an agent-verifiable input trace/frame or equivalent deterministic event assertion, bound to the corrected installed binary identity.
- [ ] The fix's Already written record and upgrade/clean-install evidence show existing `/storage` settings are preserved; no cloud action is required by the correction.

## Proposed mechanism

Move the patch's written/routed intent to an audited source-target regression. A focused product-patch guard may reject inert nested patch targets, with explicit intentional exceptions; historical audit product-diff files are not product patches. The coordinator assigns a separate source-changing brief. T42 A–D makes no product edit and leaves this bug open.

Recorded by Codex / GPT-6-Astra / xhigh, OpenAI, T5 wN:p7, Local reader. No external reviewer.
